content: expo-sqlite SDK 57: enable WAL via PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL at creation (docs tip). withTransactionAsync is NOT exclusive - outside queries get pulled in and can be rolled back; withExclusiveTransactionAsync aborts concurrent writers with database-locked and is web-unsupported. Every *Sync method warns it blocks the JS thread. execAsync does not escape parameters (SQL injection). Prepared statements need finalize in try/finally; cursors need resetAsync before re-fetch. Migrations: PRAGMA user_version pattern inside SQLiteProvider onInit. serializeAsync/backupDatabaseAsync exist for export. SQLCipher via useSQLCipher config plugin unavailable in Expo Go. getAllAsync for small sets, getEachAsync for large/infinite scroll.
